careers.title: Software Engineer / Full-Stack Architect
careers.shortDesc: Designs, codes, tests, and deploys high-scale software applications, APIs, and cloud microservices.
dayToDay: Write clean modular code in TypeScript, Go, Python, or Java.
Optimize database query latency and architecture.
Debug production outages and automate CI/CD pipelines.
Translate product roadmaps into scalable code.
careers.growthReason: Exponential digitization across Indian enterprises, global SaaS, and high-growth fintechs.

routes.title: Route 1: Traditional B.Tech CSE Path
routes.description: Structured campus placement pathway into top tech firms.
steps: Join tech companies via campus hiring

routes.title: Route 2: BCA + MCA Fast-Track
routes.description: Affordable coding-focused journey with equal placement eligibility.

routes.title: Route 3: B.Sc CS + GitHub Portfolio
routes.description: Build demonstrable open-source projects, web apps, and freelance experience.

careers.title: Data Scientist & AI / ML Engineer
careers.shortDesc: Extracts predictive insights from massive datasets and builds generative AI, LLM agents, and statistical machine learning systems.
dayToDay: Design, train, and evaluate ML models (Transformers, gradient boosting, RL).
Clean and preprocess massive terabyte-scale data pipelines.
Deploy models in production using MLOps frameworks.
Present quantifiable ROI insights to executive leaders.
careers.growthReason: The Generative AI revolution is forcing every enterprise to transform their core products with AI models.

routes.title: Route 1: B.Tech in CSE / Artificial Intelligence
routes.description: Standard engineering path with deep learning and neural network electives.

routes.title: Route 2: Elite Quantitative Route (B.Stat / B.Math at ISI)
routes.description: The golden pathway for elite high-math AI research and quantitative modeling.
steps: Joined as Senior Quantitative Modeler or Research Scientist

routes.title: Route 3: B.Sc Statistics + Certifications
routes.description: Mathematical degree followed by hands-on ML portfolio.

careers.title: UX / Product Designer (UI/UX & HCI)
careers.shortDesc: Designs intuitive, beautiful, and accessible software interfaces, design systems, and seamless user experiences.
dayToDay: Conduct user interviews and usability testing to identify friction points.
Create wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, and design systems in Figma.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure design fidelity.
Analyze product usage heatmaps and metrics.
careers.growthReason: Software products live or die by their usability; top product designers command premium compensation.

routes.title: Route 1: Formal Design Degree (B.Des via UCEED / NID)
routes.description: Comprehensive 4-year design immersion at IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, or NID.
steps: Graduate with B.Des in Interaction Design

routes.title: Route 2: Engineering Degree (B.Tech) + Self-Built Portfolio
routes.description: Very common and lucrative! Tech-savvy designers who understand code are deeply sought after.
steps: Learn Figma and UI psychology alongside college
Intern as UI/UX intern in 3rd/4th year

routes.title: Route 3: Architecture (B.Arch) to Digital UX
routes.description: Architects possess superior spatial and systems thinking that translates into design systems.
steps: Bridge spatial thinking into digital interaction systems

careers.title: Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer
careers.shortDesc: Integrates sensors, actuators, computer vision, and embedded control algorithms to build intelligent robots and autonomous drones.
dayToDay: Program microcontrollers and embedded computing units (ROS, Jetson).
Design kinematic structures and feedback control loops.
Implement SLAM and obstacle avoidance vision algorithms.
Test prototypes on factory floors or field test beds.
careers.growthReason: Surge in warehouse automation (Amazon, Flipkart), defense UAV drones, and autonomous electric vehicles.

routes.title: Route 1: B.Tech in Electronics / Mechatronics
routes.description: Multi-disciplinary engineering path combining electrical hardware and mechanical dynamics.
steps: Pursue B.Tech in Mechatronics or ECE

routes.title: Route 2: B.Tech Mechanical to Robotics Specialization
routes.description: Master physical dynamics and CAD, then add software control loops.
steps: Join autonomous vehicle or robotics firms

careers.title: Commercial Airline Pilot
careers.shortDesc: Commands commercial passenger aircraft or cargo freighters on domestic and international flight routes.
dayToDay: Review weather charts, NOTAMs, flight dispatch logs, and fuel calculations.
Perform pre-flight inspections of aircraft control surfaces and gear.
Operate flight management systems and communicate with ATC.
Handle cross-wind landings and instrument approaches.
careers.growthReason: India is the fastest-growing aviation market in the world with over 1,500 new aircraft ordered by IndiGo, Air India, and Akasa.

routes.title: Route 1: Cadet Pilot Programme (Airline Sponsored)
routes.description: Direct entry run by airlines with guaranteed employment upon license and type-rating.
steps: Clear Airline Cadet entrance & DGCA Class 1 Medical

routes.title: Route 2: Independent CPL via Flying Club (IGRUA / Abroad)
routes.description: Flexible training route where student self-finances 200 flying hours.
steps: Complete 200 flight hours at IGRUA or abroad
Convert to DGCA CPL and take airline vacancy tests

careers.title: Quantitative Analyst / Algorithmic Trader
careers.shortDesc: Builds complex mathematical models and ultra-low latency algorithmic systems to trade financial markets.
dayToDay: Formulate pricing and statistical arbitrage models for options and equities.
Backtest algorithmic trading strategies on terabytes of order book data.
Code ultra-low-latency execution engines in modern C++.
Monitor real-time value-at-risk (VaR) and dynamic hedging.
careers.salaryEntry: Rs 25L - Rs 60L+ / year (Top HFTs offer Rs 1Cr+)
careers.growthReason: Quant funds (Tower Research, Jane Street, Graviton, WorldQuant, AlphaGrep) offer highest packages in Indian campuses.

routes.title: Route 1: ISI B.Stat / B.Math Elite Quantitative Track
routes.description: ISI graduates are among the most revered in global quant finance.
steps: Recruited directly by hedge funds and proprietary desks

routes.title: Route 2: IIT B.Tech CSE / Electrical + Competitive Coding
routes.description: Top rankers in IIT Computer Science recruited for algorithmic development.
steps: Complete B.Tech in CSE / EE at top-5 IIT
Master probability and ultra-fast C++ coding
HFT on-campus hiring in final year

careers.title: Product Manager (Tech & SaaS)
careers.shortDesc: Acts as the mini-CEO of a software product, defining what to build, why, and aligning engineering with business goals.
dayToDay: Define product strategy, write PRDs, and manage feature roadmaps.
Conduct customer interviews and synthesize user pain points.
Analyze product conversion funnels, retention cohorts, and revenue metrics.
Lead sprint planning with engineers, designers, and sales.
careers.growthReason: Tech companies need strategic leaders who bridge engineering complexity and business profitability.

routes.title: Route 1: B.Tech Engineering to Software Engineer to Internal PM
routes.description: Understand tech feasibility first, then step into product ownership.
steps: Graduate with B.Tech CSE or engineering
Work as Software Engineer for 1-2 years
Actively take ownership of user problems and PRDs

routes.title: Route 2: IIM 5-Year IPM Program (Direct from 12th)
routes.description: Combines undergraduate business foundation with premier IIM management training.
steps: Complete 5-Year IPM at IIM Indore / Rohtak
Join tech firms or consulting as APM

careers.title: Military Officer (Fighter Pilot / Army Engineer)
careers.shortDesc: Commands troops, pilots supersonic fighter jets (Rafale/Su-30), or oversees high-tech electronic warfare.
dayToDay: Lead combat squadrons, regiments, or missile defense batteries.
Execute tactical operational planning, reconnaissance, and defense missions.
Maintain rigorous physical readiness and troop welfare.
Manage high-tech electronic warfare and tactical signals.
careers.salaryEntry: Rs 14L - Rs 22L / year + High perks, housing, pensions
careers.growthReason: Permanent noble profession with unparalleled prestige, leadership training, and national service.

routes.title: Route 1: National Defence Academy (NDA) after 12th PCM
routes.description: The ultimate cradle of military leadership. Commissioned as an officer at age 21.

routes.title: Route 2: B.Tech Engineering to TGC / AFCAT Technical Entry
routes.description: Graduate with engineering degree and enter armed forces directly through technical entry.
steps: Complete B.Tech in CSE, ECE, Mech, or Civil
Apply for Army TGC or Navy Tech entry

careers.title: Corporate & Cyber Technology Lawyer
careers.shortDesc: Advises tech conglomerates, venture capitals, and startups on data privacy (DPDP), intellectual property, AI governance, and mergers.
dayToDay: Draft and negotiate enterprise cloud contracts, cross-border IP licensing, and SaaS terms.
Guide companies through data breach compliance under India's DPDP Act.
File software and hardware patent applications.
Represent clients in tech arbitration disputes.
careers.growthReason: Strict privacy regulations, explosion of AI copyright issues, and soaring tech venture financings.

routes.title: Route 1: 5-Year Integrated B.A./BBA LL.B via CLAT
routes.description: Premier national law university track with tech law electives.
steps: Complete 5-Year BA/BBA LL.B at top NLU
Join Tier-1 law firms or tech legal teams

routes.title: Route 2: B.Tech Engineering to 3-Year LL.B (Patent Attorney)
routes.description: The ultimate unicorn profile! Technical science/engineering degree is mandatory to draft tech patents.
steps: Complete B.Tech in CSE, ECE, Mech or Biotech
Appear for 3-Year LL.B entrance (DU / IIT Kharagpur Law)
Command top fees drafting global tech patents

courses.description: The premier technology degree covering algorithms, software architecture, distributed systems, AI, and operating systems.

courses.name: B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering
courses.description: Bridges physical electronics and computing: semiconductors, chip design (VLSI), embedded IoT, and wireless communication.

courses.name: B.Tech in Mechanical & Mechatronics Engineering

courses.name: B.Tech in Aerospace & Avionics Engineering
courses.description: Engineering of aircraft, spacecraft, satellites, rocket propulsion, aerodynamics, and avionics control.

courses.name: B.Tech in Civil & Infrastructure Engineering
courses.description: Design and construction of megastructures, smart cities, highways, tunnels, bridges, and environmental systems.

courses.name: Bachelor of Design (Interaction, UX, Product & Visual)
courses.eligibility: 10+2 in ANY stream (PCM is fantastic for UX/Interaction).
courses.description: Focuses on user experience (UX/UI), product ergonomics, visual storytelling, and human-computer interaction (HCI).

courses.name: Bachelor of Architecture
courses.description: Professional qualification licensing individuals to design physical spaces, sustainable buildings, and urban habitats.

courses.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications
courses.description: Fast-track software degree emphasizing web development, database management, and mobile apps.

courses.name: B.Sc (Hons) in Computer Science, Data Science & AI
courses.description: Rigorous analytical foundation combining mathematics, statistics, algorithmic coding, and machine learning.

courses.name: Bachelor of Statistics / Mathematics (ISI / Central Universities)
courses.costRangeGovt: Free with Stipend at ISI; Rs 30k - Rs 1.2L in Univs
courses.description: Elite quantitative curriculum producing the highest-paid algorithmic traders, risk modelers, and AI researchers.

courses.name: National Defence Academy (Army, Air Force, Navy)
courses.costRangeGovt: Fully Funded by Govt of India (Free + Monthly allowance)
courses.description: The pinnacle of military leadership. Cadets receive formal B.Tech / B.Sc degree and are commissioned as gazetted military officers.

courses.name: Commercial Pilot License & Flight Training
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics & Math min 50% + DGCA Class 1 Medical.
courses.description: Ground aviation theory exams (DGCA) and 200 hours of instrument and multi-engine flying to pilot commercial airliners.

courses.name: Merchant Navy (B.Sc Nautical Science / Marine Engineering)
courses.eligibility: 10+2 PCM min 60% and English min 50% + 6/6 vision.
courses.description: Prepares officers to navigate and operate international cargo ships, oil tankers, and container vessels with tax-free salaries.

courses.name: Actuarial Science & Mathematical Risk Modeling
furtherStudies: Fellow of Institute of Actuaries of India (FIAI)
courses.description: High-math discipline analyzing risk in life insurance, health insurance, pensions, and capital investments.

courses.name: Integrated Programme in Management (5-Year Dual Degree at IIMs)
courses.description: Skips the fierce CAT exam, taking students right after 12th into Indian Institutes of Management for top corporate strategy roles.

courses.name: 5-Year Integrated Law (Cyber, Tech & Corporate Law)
courses.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream (Science background is heavily valued in patent law).
courses.description: Integrated legal training in constitutional, corporate, intellectual property (patent law), privacy regulations, and AI ethics.

levels.description: Widest range of technological, scientific, design, architectural, defence, and numerical career pathways.

levels.name: After 10th Standard
levels.description: Critical fork where students choose their 10+2 stream (Science PCM, PCB, Commerce, Arts) or Polytechnic Diploma.

levels.name: 12th Science (PCB/PCMB)
levels.description: Gateways to clinical medicine, pharmacy, biotechnology, clinical research, bioinformatics, and healthcare innovation.

levels.name: 12th Commerce
levels.description: Finance, corporate strategy, investment banking, charter qualifications (CA/CS/CFA), and management paths.

levels.name: 12th Arts & Humanities
levels.tagline: History, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology & Literature
levels.description: Public policy, civil services, design, journalism, legal systems, behavioral sciences, and communications.

levels.name: College / Undergraduates
levels.description: Switching domains, lateral career shifts, specialized Master's, product/business transitions, and public service.

switchingRoutes.title: From Engineering (PCM/B.Tech) to UX / Product Design
switchingRoutes.commonScenario: Enrolled in B.Tech but passionate about visual aesthetics, psychology, and creative digital interfaces rather than raw code.
switchingRoutes.howToSwitch: Design does NOT require a traditional fine arts degree. Technical students are favored in UX because they understand code feasibility.
switchingRoutes.requirements: Strong portfolio of 3-4 end-to-end case studies demonstrating problem definition, wireframing, and Figma prototypes.
switchingRoutes.timeline: 3 to 6 months of focused portfolio building, or 2-year M.Des post-graduation.
proTips: Master Figma, auto-layout, and design systems.
Redesign an existing clunky app and publish an in-depth case study on Medium or LinkedIn.
Take CEED / UCEED (IIT Bombay accepts all graduates for M.Des Interaction Design).

switchingRoutes.title: From Engineering to Product Management
switchingRoutes.commonScenario: Enjoy understanding 'why' features are built, talking to users, and steering business strategy instead of coding all day.
switchingRoutes.howToSwitch: Work as a software developer or data analyst for 1-2 years, take ownership of feature roadmaps, write PRDs, and transition internally.
switchingRoutes.requirements: Demonstrated product sense, metric fluency (retention, CAC, LTV), and user empathy.
switchingRoutes.timeline: 6 to 18 months in industry or direct post-MBA (IIMs / ISB).
proTips: Deconstruct daily products: what is their north star metric?
Volunteer to write PRD specs in your current team.
Read 'Inspired' by Marty Cagan and 'Cracking the PM Interview'.

switchingRoutes.title: From Pure Science / Math (B.Sc) to Data Science & AI
switchingRoutes.commonScenario: Did B.Sc in Maths, Physics, or Statistics, and wants high-paying industry tech roles without doing a 4-year B.Tech.
switchingRoutes.howToSwitch: Pure science students have superior mathematical foundations (calculus, probability, linear algebra) which makes advanced ML much easier.
switchingRoutes.requirements: Learn Python, SQL, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Git version control.
switchingRoutes.timeline: 4 to 8 months of self-study and building Kaggle projects, or 2-year M.Sc Data Science.
proTips: Emphasize your statistical rigor in your resume.
Publish your ML workflows on Kaggle and GitHub with clean documentation.
Apply to Junior Data Analyst roles as an entry stepping stone.
recommendedCoursesOrCerts: IIT Madras BS in Data Science

switchingRoutes.title: Polytechnic Diploma to Direct 2nd Year B.Tech (Lateral Entry)
switchingRoutes.commonScenario: Chose a 3-year Polytechnic Diploma after 10th standard instead of traditional 11th-12th school, and wants an engineering degree.
switchingRoutes.howToSwitch: Take state lateral entry exams (LEET / JELET / UPSEE Lateral). Enter directly into the 3rd semester (2nd year) of B.Tech without losing any academic years!
switchingRoutes.requirements: Completion of 3-year AICTE diploma with min 45-50% marks.
switchingRoutes.timeline: Seamless transition; finish B.Tech in 3 years instead of 4.
proTips: Diploma students usually outperform standard 12th entrants in practical engineering labs.
Revise calculus and differential equations for 2nd year B.Tech math.
Target top state govt engineering colleges with reserved 10% lateral entry seats.
recommendedCoursesOrCerts: State Lateral Entry Tests (LEET / JELET / CET Lateral)

switchingRoutes.title: From Any Degree (Science/Commerce) to Corporate & Tech Law
switchingRoutes.commonScenario: Completed or studying 12th/Graduation in non-law stream, but fascinated by contracts, patent law, policy debates, and advocacy.
switchingRoutes.howToSwitch: In India, you can enter law either via 5-year integrated law right after 12th (CLAT), or 3-year LL.B after graduation in any field!
switchingRoutes.requirements: Clear CLAT (after 12th) or CUET-PG / NLSAT (after graduation).
proTips: Science/Engineering graduates who become lawyers are the most valuable patent attorneys in the world.
Target NLSIU Bengaluru 3-Year LL.B (NLSAT) or Delhi University Faculty of Law.
Focus on reading comprehension, current affairs, and logical reasoning.

exams.name: JEE (Main)
exams.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Bio/Tech Vocational with min 75% aggregate for NITs/IIITs.
exams.frequency: Twice a year (Session 1: Jan/Feb, Session 2: Apr)
exams.patternSummary: Computer Based Test: 90 questions (Physics, Chem, Maths) with negative marking (+4 / -1).
exams.keyTips: Focus heavily on NCERT basics for Chemistry; consistent speed practice for Physics and Mathematics.

exams.name: JEE (Advanced)
exams.eligibility: Top ~2.5 lakh rankers in JEE Main with requisite category cutoff.
exams.patternSummary: Two mandatory 3-hour papers on same day testing deep multi-concept application.
exams.keyTips: Requires deep first-principles conceptual understanding rather than rote problem solving.

exams.name: UCEED
exams.fullName: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design
exams.eligibility: Students from ANY stream (PCM, PCB, Commerce, Arts) who passed 10+2.
exams.patternSummary: Part A (Computer-based test: Spatial ability, Logic) + Part B (Hand-drawn sketching).
exams.keyTips: Open to Science, Commerce, and Arts students! Unlocks IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad B.Des.

exams.name: NID DAT
exams.fullName: National Institute of Design Design Aptitude Test
exams.frequency: Once a year (Prelims in Dec/Jan, Mains in April)
exams.patternSummary: Prelims (Objective & Drawing questions) followed by DAT Mains (Studio test & portfolio).
exams.keyTips: India's premier institute for Industrial, Communication, Interaction, and Textile Design.

exams.name: CUET-UG
exams.eligibility: 10+2 passed or appearing for admission into Central and State Universities.
exams.patternSummary: Section I (Languages), Section II (Domain-specific subjects), Section III (General Test).
exams.keyTips: Gateway to Delhi University (DU), BHU, JNU for B.Sc, BCA, BA, and Integrated courses.

exams.name: NATA
exams.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics or 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics.
exams.patternSummary: Assessment of drawing and visual observation skills, aesthetic sensitivity, and architectural awareness.
exams.keyTips: Mandatory for admission to 5-year B.Arch in all government and private architecture colleges in India.

exams.name: NDA & NA Exam
exams.eligibility: Unmarried candidates aged 16.5 - 19.5 with 12th PCM for Air Force/Navy.
exams.patternSummary: Written exam (Maths + GAT: 900 marks) followed by 5-day SSB interview and medicals.
exams.keyTips: Cadet gets full B.Tech / B.Sc degree fully funded with salary and commissioned as Military Officer.

exams.name: BITSAT
exams.eligibility: 12th PCM with min 75% aggregate and min 60% in Physics, Chemistry, and Math.
exams.patternSummary: 130 questions in 3 hours: Physics, Chemistry, Math, English, and Logical Reasoning.
exams.keyTips: Admission to BITS Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad campuses (Tier 1 equivalent to top IITs).

exams.name: IMU-CET
exams.fullName: Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test
exams.eligibility: 10+2 with min 60% in PCM and 50% in English; strict 6/6 medical eye standards.
exams.patternSummary: Online CBT covering English, Aptitude, Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
exams.keyTips: Direct gateway to high-paying Merchant Navy careers (Deck Cadet, Marine Engineer).

exams.name: ISI Admission Test
exams.patternSummary: Paper 1 (MCQ in advanced math) and Paper 2 (Subjective proof-based math).
exams.keyTips: Offers 100% free tuition with monthly stipend. Alumni dominate global Quant hedge funds and AI research.

exams.name: CLAT (UG)
exams.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream (Science, Commerce, Arts) with min 45% marks.
exams.patternSummary: 120 passage-based questions evaluating English, Current Affairs, Legal Reasoning, and Logic.
exams.keyTips: Gateway to premier NLUs. Science students excel in tech-law, patents, and AI regulation.

exams.name: IPMAT
exams.fullName: Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test
exams.patternSummary: Quantitative Ability and Verbal Ability, followed by Personal Interview.
exams.keyTips: Direct 5-year BBA + MBA program into IIMs straight after 12th without waiting for CAT.

exams.name: NEET (UG)
exams.patternSummary: Pen & Paper test: 200 questions in Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology.
exams.keyTips: Single national entrance for MBBS, BDS, and AYUSH admissions across AIIMS and state colleges.
